items.q: Fill up: Urinary casts are formed in the ______.
items.exp: Cast formation: distal convoluted tubule (DCT). (Book p745)

items.q: Match each finding with its association — 1) Hyaline cast 2) Fine/coarse granular cast 3) Oval fat bodies … A) Maltese cross on polarizing microscopy B) Normal as well as kidney disease C) Kidney disease
items.exp: Hyaline: normal + kidney disease; granular: kidney disease; oval fat bodies: Maltese cross. (Book p745)
Hyaline cast: normal; kidney disease. (Book p745)

items.q: Coarse and fine granular casts signify:
items.exp: Coarse/fine granular casts: kidney disease. (Book p745)
